description: This file implements an internationalization (i18n) manager class for handling locale settings, translations, and localization features in a web application. It manages locale persistence, loading, and translation retrieval with fallback support.

classes.name: I18nManager
classes.description: A class managing internationalization, including locale state, translation loading, and subscriber notifications.

methods.name: readStoredLocale
methods.description: Reads the saved locale from local storage.

methods.name: persistLocale
methods.description: Saves the current locale to local storage.

methods.name: resolveInitialLocale
methods.description: Determines the initial locale based on stored preferences or navigator settings.

methods.name: loadLocale
methods.description: Loads and sets the initial locale during initialization.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets a new locale, loading translations if necessary, and notifies subscribers.

methods.name: registerTranslation
methods.description: Registers a translation map for a specific locale.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Adds a subscriber callback to be notified on locale changes.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Notifies all subscribers of a locale change.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Retrieves the translation string for a given key, with optional parameters for interpolation.
